tools.name: loadCollectionData
tools.title: Load Collection Data
tools.description: Fetches and parses all rows from the primary Collections sheet, ensuring the data is structured correctly for display in the application (including normalized dates, times, amounts, receipts, remarks, Aman's remarks, allocation categories, Already Paid flags, and conflict status).

limit.description: Max number of rows to return (0 = all rows).

tools.name: read_all_collections
tools.title: Read every row in complete Collections sheet
tools.description: Reads every row in the complete Collections sheet without limits or omissions. Includes executive, loanId, amount, payment date, time, entryDate, entryType, settlement, receipts, remark, actualId, Aman's Remarks (Column S), case category, allocation date, and Already Paid flags.

limit.description: Max rows to return (0 for no limit).

search.description: Optional search term across loanId, remark, amansRemarks, or executive.

tools.name: loan_summary
tools.title: Loan Summary & Sequential EMI Tracking
tools.description: Calculates loan-level metrics across collection history: total paid, sequential EMI counts, short EMI amounts, foreclosure/settlement status, POS paid, and Main Paid status. Excludes Already Paid records by default.

status.description: Optional status filter (e.g. 'EMI Paid', 'Settlement Paid', 'Foreclosure Paid', 'EMI Short Amount', 'POS Paid — Not Main Paid').

mainPaidOnly.description: If true, only returns Main Paid cases.

tools.name: short_emi_cases
tools.title: List Short EMI Cases
tools.description: Lists collection cases that have an active EMI shortfall (where the borrower paid partially towards an EMI). Shows which EMI is short, remaining short amount, executive, and POS status.

tools.name: loan_payments
tools.title: Payments for a Loan ID
tools.description: List all recorded payments for one Loan ID, including Already Paid flags.

tools.name: executive_city_report
tools.title: Executive City Report & Performance Breakdown
tools.description: Generates executive-wise city breakdown tables showing collection amount, case count, Main Paid cases, paid EMI count, POS* cases, and paid POS amount per executive and city, along with summary totals.

includeBucket.description: If true, breaks down rows by City + Bucket instead of City only.

excludeAlreadyPaid.description: If true, excludes Already Paid cases (default true).

tools.name: detailed_report
tools.title: Comprehensive Daily and Monthly Collection Report
tools.description: Produces full analytical collection report matching the application's Reports tab: date-wise collection totals, executive breakdown (including Normal vs Previous Paid case counts, Main Paid cases, Paid EMIs, POS*), bucket-wise totals, and city/bucket sections. Already Paid cases are excluded.

tools.name: collection_summary
tools.title: Collection summary by executive
tools.description: Total collection amount and case count per executive for a payment date range (Already Paid cases excluded).

tools.name: list_already_paid
tools.title: List Already Paid Cases
tools.description: Lists payment entries made prior to their Allocation Date (Already Paid cases). These are kept for reference and excluded from all official collection totals.

tools.name: highlight_already_paid
tools.title: Highlight Already Paid rows in Google Sheet
tools.description: Highlights Already Paid rows (payments made before their allocation date) with a soft red background in Google Sheets so they are visually distinguished.

rows.description: Optional array of row numbers to highlight. If omitted or empty, all Already Paid rows in the sheet are automatically detected and highlighted.

tools.name: open_receipt_image
tools.title: Open receipt images directly in Google Drive
tools.description: Resolves and provides direct Google Drive view, preview, and download links for collection receipt images. Can look up receipts by Loan ID, Google Sheet row number, or direct Drive URL/File ID.

receiptUrl.description: Google Drive file URL or File ID.

loanId.description: Loan ID to find all attached receipts for.

rowNumber.description: Collections sheet row number to find receipts for.

tools.name: upload_receipt_image
tools.title: Upload receipt image to Google Drive
tools.description: Uploads a receipt image (base64 string or data URL) to Google Drive, returning the public Google Drive link. Optionally attaches it to an existing Collections row in Google Sheets and/or runs OCR extraction.

base64.description: Base64 string or data URL of the receipt image.

rowNumber.description: Optional row number in Collections sheet. If provided, the uploaded receipt link will be immediately attached to this entry in Google Sheets (Column P).

runOcr.description: If true, runs OCR extraction on the receipt to extract amount, loan ID, date, and UTR.

tools.name: attach_receipt_to_payment
tools.title: Attach receipt image to an existing payment entry
tools.description: Attaches a receipt image to an existing row in Collections sheet. Either uploads a new base64 receipt image to Google Drive or links an existing URL, appending it to Column P in Google Sheets.

rowNumber.description: Row number in Collections sheet to attach the receipt to.

loanNumber.description: Optional Loan ID for file naming.

receiptBase64.description: Base64 string or data URL of the receipt image to upload and attach.

receiptFileName.description: File name for the uploaded receipt.

receiptUrl.description: Pre-existing receipt URL to attach directly.

tools.name: pending_receipts
tools.title: Pending receipts
tools.description: List payments still waiting in Pending Receipts queue, including pending ID, receipt photo links, amount, executive, and settlement flag.

tools.name: record_pending
tools.title: Record a pending receipt entry
tools.description: Records a payment entry in the Pending Receipts queue awaiting confirmation. Photos are uploaded to Google Drive.

settlement.description: Whether this is a settlement payment.

photos.description: Receipt photos to upload to Google Drive.

tools.name: complete_pending
tools.title: Complete pending receipt & create collection
tools.description: Marks a pending receipt entry as 'Done' and automatically appends it to the Collections sheet as a Confirmed Normal payment.

pendingId.description: Pending entry ID (e.g. 'PND-1718000000000') to mark as completed.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.title: Record a loan collection payment with optional receipt upload
tools.description: Records a payment collection entry into Google Sheets (Collections sheet) with executive, loan ID, amount, date, and optional receipt image upload (uploaded to Google Drive just like in the app UI). Automatically classifies as Normal or Previous Paid File based on date.

receiptLinks.description: Optional array of pre-existing public receipt/photo URLs.

receiptPhotos.description: Optional array of receipt images to upload to Google Drive during entry (just like in the app UI).

base64.description: Base64 string or data URL of the image.

receiptBase64.description: Optional single base64 string or data URL of a receipt photo to upload to Google Drive.

tools.name: update_payment
tools.title: Update an existing payment entry row
tools.description: Updates an existing collection row in the Google Sheet (Collections sheet) by its row number (e.g. correcting amount, date, time, executive, or remark).

rowNumber.description: Google Sheet row number to update (row 1 is header).

amansRemarks.description: Aman's Remarks (Column S in Collections sheet).

tools.name: delete_payment
tools.title: Delete a payment collection row
tools.description: Deletes an erroneous or duplicate payment collection row from Google Sheets by row number.

rowNumber.description: Row number in Collections sheet to delete (2 or greater).

tools.name: edit_collection_amount
tools.title: Edit payment collection amount
tools.description: Edits the collection payment amount (Column C in Collections sheet) for an entry by its row number or Loan ID. Updates Google Sheets directly.

amount.description: New corrected collection amount in rupees.

rowNumber.description: Google Sheet row number to update (row 1 is header).

loanId.description: Loan ID (used if rowNumber is not provided).

tools.name: write_amans_remarks
tools.title: Write to Aman's Remarks in Collections sheet
tools.description: Writes, updates, or appends a note to 'Aman's Remarks' (Column S in Collections sheet) for a specific row number or Loan ID. Directly updates Google Sheets.

remarks.description: The text content to write into Aman's Remarks (Column S).

rowNumber.description: Google Sheet row number to update (row 1 is header).

loanId.description: Loan account ID (used to locate the row if rowNumber is not provided).

append.description: If true, appends to existing remarks instead of overwriting.

tools.name: list_ecs_entries
tools.title: List ECS and Special entries
tools.description: Lists ECS and Special collection entries from Google Sheets with optional status or executive filter.

status.description: Status filter: All, Confirmed, Bounced, Cancelled, or Cleared.

tools.name: record_ecs_entry
tools.title: Record an ECS or Special payment entry
tools.description: Records a new ECS or Special collection transaction into Google Sheets (ECS_Special_Info tab).

tools.name: update_ecs_entry
tools.title: Update ECS entry status
tools.description: Updates status and remark for an ECS or Special payment entry in Google Sheets (ECS_Special_Info tab).

status.description: New status: Confirmed, Bounced, Cancelled, or Cleared.

tools.name: list_conflicts
tools.title: List payment conflicts and duplicates
tools.description: Detects potential duplicate payment entries (same Loan ID and payment amount) with comparison details, receipt links, row numbers, and validation status ('VALIDATED' vs unvalidated).

unresolvedOnly.description: If true, only returns groups where at least one entry is unvalidated.

tools.name: resolve_conflict
tools.title: Resolve payment conflict
tools.description: Resolves a payment conflict row by marking it valid ('VALIDATED'), reverting its validation, or deleting the duplicate row from Google Sheets.

action.description: Action to take on the conflicting row: 'mark_valid', 'revert_validation', or 'delete_entry'.

rowNumber.description: Row number in Collections sheet to resolve.

tools.name: resolve_conflict_group
tools.title: Validate entire conflict group
tools.description: Marks a whole group of conflicting collection rows as valid ('VALIDATED') in a single operation and clears their red highlighting in Google Sheets.

rows.description: Array of row numbers belonging to the conflict group to validate.

tools.name: highlight_conflicts
tools.title: Highlight payment conflicts in Google Sheet
tools.description: Highlights duplicate/conflicting collection rows in Google Sheets with a red background so they are clearly visible in the source spreadsheet.

rows.description: Optional array of row numbers to mark in red. If omitted or empty, all conflicting unvalidated rows are automatically detected and highlighted.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.title: Get app settings and feature flags
tools.description: Returns the current feature toggle flags (entry, report, loans, execCities, pending, ecs, notifications, alreadyPaid, conflicts), default allocation category, and active announcement banners.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.title: Update app settings and feature flags
tools.description: Updates application feature visibility toggles (flags) or the default allocation category in the AppSettings sheet tab.

flags.description: Feature flags to update, e.g. { entry: true, report: true, loans: true, execCities: true, pending: true, ecs: true, notifications: true, alreadyPaid: true, conflicts: true, remarks: true }

defaultCategory.description: Default allocation category (e.g. 'Standard', 'Priority', or empty string for all).

tools.name: add_notification
tools.title: Add announcement notification
tools.description: Publishes a new announcement notification banner into Google Sheets (Notifications tab).

imageUrl.description: Optional public image URL to display.

tools.name: remove_notification
tools.title: Remove announcement notification
tools.description: Deactivates an active announcement notification banner by ID.

tools.name: sheets_read_write
tools.title: Direct Google Sheets Read and Write
tools.description: Directly reads, appends, or updates row data across any tab in the Google Spreadsheet (e.g. Collections, ECS_Special_Info, AppSettings, Notifications, or Monthly sheets).

action.description: Operation to perform: 'get' to read rows, 'append' to add rows, 'update' to overwrite a range.

range.description: Google Sheet range in A1 notation (e.g. 'Collections!A1:J20', 'AppSettings!A1:B', 'ECS_Special_Info!A:L').

values.description: 2D matrix of row values to write when using 'append' or 'update'.
